svg.title: FoveaWAM Fig. 2
svg.desc: FoveaWAM method architecture. Current RGB-D and target/robot histories form scene tokens; a shared masked-attention transformer uses separate world and action FFNs. Training-only heads predict sparse scene flow and target SE(3). Actions read scene and summary tokens. World conditioning is cached for five Euler action steps. The matched backbone baseline retains this token/mask topology and changes parameter ownership. All graphics are editable schematic vector objects.

g.text: World once per query · action-only denoising
Geometry readouts are omitted at inference
